name: RC-B10-0497/2026 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Ukrainian children forcibly deported or living in Russian-occupied territories in Ukraine
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on Russia to return all Ukrainian children who were deported or forcibly transferred, and says this must happen without conditions. It condemns Russia's deportations, illegal adoptions, forced Russification and military training of Ukrainian children, and says these acts meet the legal definition of genocide. It asks European Union countries to recognise this, to sanction everyone involved, and to support the children's return and recovery. The text is the Parliament's position and set of demands; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament demands action and asks European Union countries to act.
- **Who it affects:** Ukrainian children taken to Russia, Belarus and North Korea, and their families.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to European Union governments and institutions, Ukraine and Russia for follow-up.
